remarks: GROUNDS MAINTENANCE INCLUDED. Presenting a meticulously maintained 3-4 bedrooms home situated on a spacious half-acre lot in the coveted Club Rd neighborhood. Step inside to discover an inviting open concept living space, highlighted by a recently renovated kitchen featuring a center island, granite counter tops and stainless-steel appliances. The breakfast nook and separate dining area effortlessly flow into the large, light-filled living room, creating an ideal setting for both casual gatherings and formal entertaining. There are beautiful hardwood floors throughout the entire home. The generously sized den or family room offers a versatile space for relaxation and leisure. In addition the first floor offers a spacious office or 1st fl bedroom. The primary bedroom is spacious and includes a full bath, additionally there is a very large second bedroom and a generously proportioned third bedroom, ensuring comfort and ample space.  Outside, the expansive private backyard with a sizeable patio sets the stage for outdoor enjoyment. With a two-car garage equipped with charging station, walk up attic; parking and storage are effortlessly taken care of. The property also boasts a new efficient central air and gas heating system. Perfectly positioned, this home enjoys a prime location just minutes away from schools, shops, dining options, and convenient to all transportation, close proximity Sterling Farms Golf Club
